---
name: "✨ Feature Request"
about: Suggest a new script, tool, dashboard, or improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## ✨ Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature, tool, or script you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem / Use Case

What problem does this solve? What IT/administrative task or workflow does this support?
(e.g., "As an Intune administrator, I need a way to quickly export devices that have failed compliance for more than 7 days.")

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this working — parameters, expected output, target platform (Intune, SCCM, Azure, M365, Entra ID, AVD, Security, Dashboard, etc.).

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions, workarounds, or existing tools you've considered.

## 📂 Suggested Category

- [ ] `/scripts` — general administrative script
- [ ] `/tools` — multi-file utility
- [ ] `/dashboards` — reporting/dashboard
- [ ] `/docs` — documentation only
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## 📎 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, sample data structures, or references here.

## 🙋 Would you be willing to contribute this yourself?

- [ ] Yes, I can submit a PR
- [ ] I'd like guidance to build it
- [ ] No, just suggesting the idea
